mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the supporting tissue with blood vessels was most worthwhile because it showed how the living outer cells get supplies even though their layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the completed sweat gland to its named slot was straightforward, but it did not reveal much on its own.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from the tissue beneath it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing how the skin's parts worked together was interesting, especially the detail about its blood supply, though some slot-fitting was predictable.
